description: The custom font families uploaded by the user on their brand page (family name, format, size and upload time, never the font bytes). Read this before choosing brand fonts or rendering templates so you can use a family the business already uploaded. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.
